introduction_markdown: This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: answer ALL the questions (15 questions); the mark allocation for each question is indicated. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. Duration: two and a half hours.

questions.enonce_markdown: During an auction sale, a shop reduced the prices of its articles by 10%. Calculate the selling price of an article originally priced at 43000 FCFA. *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
A reduction of 10% means the article is sold at $100\% - 10\% = 90\%$ of its original price.

Reduction: $\dfrac{10}{100}\times 43\,000 = 4\,300$ FCFA.

Selling price: $43\,000 - 4\,300 = 38\,700$ FCFA.

Check: $0.9\times 43\,000 = 38\,700$.

**Answer: 38,700 FCFA.**
